svg.title: Config mutation paths
svg.desc: PATCH /api/config and the settings form POST /settings call ConfigApplyService.apply: re-read the file, validate, partition the fields by mutability, and write every validated field through ConfigWriter with a backup. Live fields then fire ConfigChangedEvent, reloadable fields go through ConfigNotifier.reload, and restart fields, or a failed reload, are recorded in restart.pending. The toggle routes change runtime state only and write nothing.

g.text: Hover a box for what it does; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Edge labels on the right are the field tier: live, reloadable (reload) or restart. Inside a rendered document this image is static.

svg.text: One apply authority for PATCH and the settings form. Every validated field is written; mutability decides only how it is applied.

g.class: e join f-m4 t-ev t-reload t-pend

g.text: PATCH /api/config · config_api_routes.dart: 403 without admin access; scheduling.jobs is refused (use the job endpoints)
The route only parses a body and calls apply, so it cannot disagree with the settings form on what validates.
POST /settings · web/settings/settings_surface.dart coerces the form through FieldMeta.type and diffs against current values
It re-renders the section either way, whether apply wrote anything or refused.
re-read the file; callers normalize first
freshConfig() · both callers run normalizeConfigPatch (blank-to-null, provider/model shorthand, task-trigger spelling) before apply
freshConfig loads the file as it stands and carries the container posture in force, not the one the file declares.
ConfigValidator.validate · known field, then writable, then FieldConstraints, then entry shape, then cross-field rules
Any error means nothing is written and nothing is applied.
partition by mutability · ConfigMeta mutability per field; readonly never gets here, the validator refused it
With no ConfigNotifier wired, every reloadable field is treated as restart-required.
ConfigWriter.updateFields · queued write, fresh read, comment-preserving yaml_edit, backup first (abort if it fails), then rename
Live, reloadable and restart fields are all written, so every change survives a restart.
validation errors · ConfigApplyResult.errors lists the refused fields in submission order
applied and pendingRestart are both empty when errors is non-empty.
dartclaw.yaml · the operator file, authoritative and the only persistent store of configuration
A symlinked config path is written through to its target and the link survives.
ConfigNotifier.reload · apply reads loadDartclawConfig(file) and passes it to the notifier, which applies section deltas
A throw is logged and the reloadable fields fall back to pending restart.
a banner shows on every page until restart
writeRestartPending · restart_service.dart: {timestamp, fields}, merged and atomically replaced
Pages read it to show the banner; RestartService consumes it after a restart.
live keys only, exact dotted keys
ConfigChangedEvent · fired on the EventBus for live fields only; reloadable fields go through the notifier
ConfigChangeSubscriber handles four exact keys; ScopeReconciler handles sessions.dm_scope and group_scope.
Nothing is written and the state resets on restart.
RuntimeToggleApplier · runtime_toggle_applier.dart is the only writer of WorkspaceGitSync.pushEnabled and its RuntimeConfig fields
It changes runtime state only; persistence belongs to the caller.
